# OpenDM

> Open-source, self-hosted Instagram and Facebook comment-to-DM automation on Cloudflare Workers + D1. Keyword comments get a private reply, an optional follow/like gate, optional email capture, and a link. AGPL-3.0, by SS Enterprises (https://vibemastery.io).

OpenDM runs in your own Cloudflare account. It has a dashboard, a CLI, and an MCP server (remote at /mcp, and stdio) so AI agents can deploy, onboard and manage flows.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/charanjit-singh/opendm/blob/main/README.md): what it is, deploy button, set up with Claude
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/charanjit-singh/opendm/blob/main/AGENTS.md): instructions and the onboarding playbook for AI agents
- [docs/ai-agents.md](https://github.com/charanjit-singh/opendm/blob/main/docs/ai-agents.md): MCP, CLI, safety rules, limits
